subject: g3
title: Aggressive Context Dehydration: post-compaction history is offloaded to linked fragment files and replaced by metadata stubs the model can selectively rehydrate via a capacity-gated tool
one_why: Third tier above thin+summarize that never throws information away - stubs carry topics/tool-summary/token estimates so the model itself decides what rehydration is worth, and the rehydrate path checks remaining window capacity before restoring (acd.rs:281-286); no other subject in findings/ makes compaction reversible. Clean-room only (manifest-only license).

subject: g3
title: Three-tier overflow ladder: disk-thinning on a 50/60/.../80% step ladder, then proportional-trigger summarization, then ACD - each tier tried before the next
one_why: should_compact is deliberately purely proportional (comment forbids reintroducing an absolute token guard that compacted 1M windows at 15%) and thinning re-fires in decades until 80% hands off to compaction - cheap-tier-first ordering with a per-tier escape hatch; convergence with existing compaction-tiering id.

subject: g3
title: Rolling cache_control breakpoints capped and slid forward: max 3 rolling + system block, cleared when the budget would overflow, including on new user turns
one_why: Written against a live incident (session butler_ed85ce50451a4380 accumulated 9 breakpoints and now 400s permanently, lib.rs:1253-1266) - the budget-enforce-and-slide pattern is exactly what naive cache_control stampers need; nuance on existing prompt-cache-marking id.

subject: g3
title: MockProvider drives the real streaming+tool loop and the real retry path, with contract-first test docs (fallback model's 4-point contract stated in the header)
one_why: Header states 'Asserting on the registry alone would not prove the agent ever consults it' - tests exercise Agent::execute_task->stream_with_retry end to end; many g3 tests are named after the real defect they pin (abrupt_stop_bug_test, eager_session_write_test), a maintenance-culture signal worth copying.

subject: g3
title: ~27.6k LOC of property-named tests and zero CI: no .github/, no workflow files, nothing runs the suite automatically
evidence: find crates -path '*/tests/*' -name '*.rs' | wc -l = 26,635 LOC; ls .github -> absent; scripts/ contains only install/signing helpers
one_why: Verification ceiling is absolute here: the tests prove real properties (concurrency invariants, UTF-8 truncation, resume trimming) but a single cargo check in CI is the cheapest upgrade in the corpus; convergence with test-suite-without-ci (4 others).

subject: g3
title: No execution gate at all: shell and background_process run model commands unconditionally; the only enforcement-shaped control is a plan-mode git-dirty gate that advises the LLM via injected text and does not revert
evidence: crates/g3-core/src/tools/shell.rs:73-133 (direct execute_bash_streaming_in_dir),157-211; crates/g3-core/src/tools/plan.rs:1052-1135; plan.rs:1564 test_approval_gate_warns_without_reverting; lib.rs:3830-3836; no SECURITY.md in tree
one_why: Default posture is full autonomous with blast-radius = user's machine; the plan gate is LLM-mediated (a Blocked string in conversation), so any model that ignores instructions bypasses it - honesty is at least intact (no sandbox is claimed) but nothing underneath binds.

subject: g3
title: Filesystem mailbox lets external processes inject user messages into a running turn: one file per message in .g3/sessions/<id>/inbox/, drained at the top of every streaming iteration, deliberately at-most-once
one_why: Rationale is written down: create_new prevents clobber, and losing a message beats replaying a stale interjection hours later ('reads as the agent hallucinating a user request') - steering-a-running-agent via the session dir instead of a socket is the cheapest interop surface in the corpus; concept id new (grep: no inbox/mid-turn concepts in findings/).

subject: g3
title: Eager per-iteration session.json snapshots marked 'running', with unanswered-tool-call trim on restore to satisfy Anthropic's tool_use/tool_result pairing invariant
one_why: Documents a measured loss (10/219 real sessions had no transcript, largest lost 210 messages) then pins both properties of the fix - mid-turn snapshots must be readable-and-marked and must trim orphans; nuance on session-rollout-journal: the trim-on-restore rule is the transferable bit for any Anthropic-facing resume.

subject: g3
title: MIT declared in Cargo.toml and README but no LICENSE file anywhere in the tree
evidence: Cargo.toml:37 license="MIT"; README.md:506 'MIT License'; find . -iname '*licen*' (excl .git): no results
one_why: Intent is permissive but a manifest string is not a license grant; all g3 findings above are concept-level and effort_for_us assumes clean-room reimplementation until a LICENSE file (or upstream confirmation) exists; convergence with manifest-only-license.

subject: g3
title: lib.rs is 4,155 LOC fusing the Agent struct, the streaming tool loop, cache-breakpoint policy, mid-turn injection and duplicate detection
one_why: The workspace split is otherwise real (compaction/context_window/acd/pending_input are separate modules), but any loop-semantics change touches the same 4k-line file - per the pi errata rule, loop-and-policy fusion in one product-surface file is the docking factor that holds g3's architecture at 6.
